description: M5 irreducible-set case: a single user turn larger than the compaction budget
origin_note: Synthetic, not captured: a conversation reduced to one oversized turn does not occur in a real Claude Code session on demand. The size is constructed: a small hand-written core padded with deterministic filler so the serialized messages exceed the model-derived compaction budget. This entry pins section 6.1's current observed behaviour (compaction engages and returns the conversation unchanged); the design question for the irreducible case remains open as gap G17. The mandatory human-review step is replaced by code-review of the builder (this script), the scrubber's full-byte scan in CI, and a bounded head/tail human read of the committed .body file, per TEST_SUITE.md section 7.1.1.
